messages:
emma: We got feedback from two customers that the saved view preview (the little cost estimate) is misleading when the view includes compare-mode + long context models. It underestimates token burn.

ryan: Can you paste example?

emma: Steps: enable compare mode across 3 models, set time range to 90d, run preview -> shows ~1.2k tokens / $0.02. Real run against sample traffic burned ~12k tokens.

maya: Oof. That's a big gap. Likely because preview currently samples 100 rows and extrapolates linearly by route traffic, but compare-mode multiplies per-row tokens by model count and longer sequences increase average tokens nonlinearly.

lee: Backend notes: preview pipeline currently computes median token per-call from the last 7d autosample and multiplies by est_calls = daily_traffic * days. We don't account for compare expansion, rerankers, or KV cache hit-rate.

ryan: Proposal: extend preview API to return per-model breakdown + sampling uncertainty band. E.g. response: `{
  estimated_tokens: 1200,
  estimated_cost_cents: 24,
  model_breakdown: [{model: "rwd-3b", est_tokens: 400}, {model: "rwd-1b-qa", est_tokens: 800}],
  sample_rate: 0.01,
  ci_lower: 800,
  ci_upper: 18000
}`

tina: Uncomfortable: exposing wide CI might scare users. Maybe show best-effort estimate plus a small badge: "est. cost per 30d: $X (±Y)" and a link "why this varies".

emma: Agree on UX: keep default lean but make advanced details one click away. In the modal: show single-line headline, then a caret to expand model breakdown and sampling assumptions. Also a checkbox: "Run a detailed dry-run (costs tokens)" that lets users execute a controlled sample run (server-side) to get tighter estimate.

lee: Implementation: add `POST /api/savedviews/preview` with query param `detailed=true|false`. Detailed spawns a sandboxed dry-run job that consumes controlled tokens and returns exact counts for the sample. We'll require Idempotency-Key.

ryan: Telemetry plan: `savedview_preview_shown`, `savedview_preview_detail_clicked`, `savedview_preview_dryrun_started`, `savedview_preview_dryrun_completed` with labels: route_id, model_list, sample_rate, ci_span. Also emit alert if `ci_upper/ci_lower > 10` for high-variance routes.

maya: routing policy impact: for Dedicated customers we should use their pinned model for preview. For hosted customers show the current routing decision. Need to embed `routed_model` label.

lee: Backend caution: dry-run jobs could be abused. We'll rate-limit by account and require feature-flag. Also quota costs apply and we must surface that in the modal: "Dry-run will consume up to ~X tokens from your account quota."

emma: Small UX copy idea: headline: "Estimated token & cost preview" subline: "Approximate. Use Detailed run to measure more precisely (may consume quota)." Buttons: [Preview] [Detailed dry-run] [Cancel].

ryan: API example for docs: ```bash
curl -X POST "https://api.redwood.ai/v1/savedviews/preview" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \
  -H "Idempotency-Key: $(uuidgen)" \
  -d '{"route_id":"r_abc123","filters":{...},"days":30,"compare_mode":true,"detailed":false}'
```

lee: QA: add e2e that compares preview est vs dry-run actual within 30% for low-variance routes and flags high-variance. Add unit tests for model_breakdown arithmetic including cache-hit modifiers.

ops-bot: Note: sample-run quota deduction logged to billing dataset as `dryrun_tokens_consumed`.

maya: Rollout: feature-flag the detailed dry-run and advanced breakdown. Start canary with internal customers + 2 pilot customers. Collect telemetry for 2 weeks then evaluate.

ryan: Also update console telemetry dashboard: new panel for preview variance and dry-run usage by route, and an alert when a route's preview CI_upper > 5x median.

emma: Action items: lee -> backend preview API + rate-limit (ETA 3d). ryan -> telemetry & dashboard tiles (ETA 4d). maya -> UX copy + modal mockups (ETA 2d). tina -> QA plan + tests (ETA 5d).

lee: I'll send a PR draft tomorrow with API schema.

(misc attachments: screenshot of old preview and raw dry-run logs)
